2608.02553.title: A Taxonomy of Cognitive Capability Gaps in Generative and Agentic AI
2608.02553.paper_summary: Cognitive AI seeks to move beyond language generation and autonomous task execution toward systems capable of sustained reasoning, adaptive behavior, persistent memory, and self-regulation. While generative and agentic AI have demonstrated impressive capabilities across a wide range of tasks, many fundamental cognitive functions remain fragmented or weakly developed, limiting reliable operation over extended time horizons. This paper presents a taxonomy-driven survey of the major cognitive capability gaps that continue to constrain the development of Cognitive AI. The literature is organized around five dimensions: persistent state modeling, goal-directed autonomy, self-monitoring and control, environment interaction, and learning and adaptation. For each dimension, we review recent advances, identify recurring limitations, and discuss open research challenges. Building on these insights, we outline a conceptual Adaptive Cognitive Intelligence Architecture (ACIA) and examine emerging directions in cognition-centric evaluation. The proposed taxonomy provides a unified framework for organizing existing research, identifying unresolved challenges, and guiding the design of future cognitively capable systems. Together, the taxonomy, architectural perspective, and evaluation framework offer a roadmap for advancing AI systems that exhibit more reliable long-term reasoning, adaptive decision-making, and continual learning. The survey highlights key research opportunities toward more adaptive, reliable, and cognitively capable AI systems, providing a foundation for future progress toward Cognitive AI and, ultimately, Artificial General Intelligence (AGI).
2608.02553.paper_summary_zh: 認知人工智慧旨在超越語言生成和自主任務執行，朝向能夠持續推理、適應行為、持久記憶和自我調節的系統。雖然生成式和代理式人工智慧在各種任務中展示了令人印象深刻的能力，但許多基本的認知功能仍然是片段化或發展不足，限制了在長期時間範圍內的可靠運作。本文呈現了一個基於分類法的調查，探討了繼續制約認知人工智慧發展的主要認知能力缺口。文獻圍繞五個維度進行組織：持久狀態建模、目標導向的自主性、自我監控與控制、環境互動，以及學習與適應。對於每個維度，我們回顧了最近的進展，識別了反覆出現的限制，並討論了未解的研究挑戰。在這些見解的基礎上，我們概述了一個概念性的自適應認知智能架構（ACIA），並檢視了以認知為中心的評估新方向。所提出的分類法提供了一個統一的框架，用於組織現有研究、識別未解決的挑戰，並指導未來具認知能力系統的設計。總體而言，分類法、架構視角和評估框架為推進展現更可靠的長期推理、適應性決策和持續學習的人工智慧系統提供了一條路線圖。調查突顯了朝向更具適應性、可靠性和認知能力的人工智慧系統的關鍵研究機會，為未來向認知人工智慧以及最終的人工通用智慧（AGI）邁進奠定了基礎。
